annotations.title: List what a design can change

description: Use this when the person asks what a chosen Webba design can change, or to search the graphics that exist, such as 'stacked boxes'. Only what's listed can be applied. It changes nothing. Do not use this to make a change, which is update_design, or for logos made elsewhere.

search.description: Optional words to look for among the builder's graphics.

state.description: The design's state exactly as returned by the last Webba tool result. Don't edit it by hand.
